assessment: Official Tirunelveli District Administration evidence establishes a local Assistant Director of Survey and Land Records and links the Tamil Nadu land-record e-Services. registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Tirunelveli District Administration page naming the Assistant Director of Survey and Land Records at the Collector office in Kokkirakulam, Tirunelveli. This establishes local service custody only; it is not source integration, ownership evidence, or proof of citywide parcel availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official district page lists Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR, A-Register, verification services, links Tamil Nadu e-Services, and names the Assistant Director of Survey and Land Records in Tirunelveli.
Official district page provides district, revenue-division, and taluk administrative maps; no parcel feature service or parcel schema is exposed on the reviewed page.
Official TNGIS application page identifies Tamil Nadu GIS and its public-information disclaimer; no usable parcel response was obtained in this pass.
Official Tamil Nadu Government Land Management System describes land-parcel and land-survey modules, but the reviewed portal presents department login with email/mobile, password, and CAPTCHA.

Official NIC Tamil Nadu notice describes Integrated Land Record combining textual records, FMB/maps, and Chitta, and links the official services; it does not document a safe anonymous parcel feature endpoint.
